quest.title: Chili Con Cloudy
quest.description: You encounter an anxious merchant in a camp out in the wild...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Dear passersby, could you please help a poor old man?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: My precious Yun has gone missing. I've searched all over for it, but it's nowhere to be found... Well, there's a Treasure Hoarder camp too, but I dare not go there...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yun?

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: My precious, yes! My Yunyun, a Sumpter Beast by that name!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A Sumpter Beast... Huh. So people from Liyue keep those too, do they?

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Well, moving large quantities of cargo through the mountains is always a challenge for merchants who run long routes like we do. Cows are too slow, while mules and ponies carry too little, and arranging for food and drink for porters is too expensive...

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: So I had this idea — what if I simply bought a few Sumpter Beasts of good stock from Sumeru? That way, I'd be able to transport goods in bulk without worry!

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: I didn't think that someone would just... steal my Sumpter Beast just as I entered Chenyu Vale! Ah... My Yun! My Mora!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Err, d—don't cry! You're a grown man, y'know?

choices.text: Did you really save any money by not renting mules...?

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: You can't calculate it so simply. Look, the Sumpter Beasts I bought come in a group, and they're of good stock, too. As long as I'm successful in breeding them, I've no doubt that they'll have adapted to Liyue's environment in two to three generations.

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Hehe, and once those two to three generations have passed, I'll rent my grown Sumpter Beasts out or sell them off — that's how I'll recoup all my costs!

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: *sigh* But right now, as you can see... Ah, what a loss! My Yun...

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: I bought these three precious Sumpter Beasts, and it was such an effort, too... Never mind how I feel about them...

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Chili has always been the most obedient, and it's been here all this time. Jue was very mischievous, and ran off long ago.

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: If even Yun should leave me... It would be a loss I could never, ever recover from!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah... Well, the remaining Sumpter Beast definitely seems to be having a hard time. All alone, without any companions...

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Surely, you two kind souls will help me, right? I've been wallowing here in my trouble for half the day, and only you two have paid me any mind...

choices.text: Actually, we're just passing through, too...

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: What?

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Ah! Right, I understand... Don't worry, I know the rules. Rest assured, you need not worry about compensation.

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Should we go now, in that case? I worry for what the Treasure Hoarders might have done to Yun!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well then, where's their camp?

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Hah, allow me to lead the way!

choices.text: Well, you look like you need help, so we're to provide it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we couldn't just leave you sitting there being all sad like that!

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Ah, you are... truly heroes imbued with chivalrous spirits, and good souls besides! Such fine people you are!

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Well... I know where the Treasure Hoarder camp is. Allow me to lead the way, and then you can teach them a bit of a lesson!

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Should we go now, in that case? I worry for what the Treasure Hoarders might have done to Yun!

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Allow me to lead the way!

choices.text: Can you give us any leads?

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Well, this... I don't... Actually, wait! I did say earlier that there was a Treasure Hoarder camp nearby, right? Yun's disappearance must have something to do with them!

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Those crooks have been active in this area all this time. If I hadn't spent all the funds allocated for guards on the Sumpter Beasts, then maybe... *sigh*

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: As their name would suggest, they steal treasures, don't they? Well, then, I think they were the ones who stole Yun!

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Yun! My Yun! I've come to take you home!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yun?

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: It's my precious, my baby Yunyun, stolen by these Treasure Hoarders!

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: I've been a merchant for many years, and all my savings went into my three precious Sumpter Beasts. Chili is the most obedient and has always stayed with me. Jue, the most mischievous, ran off a long time ago...

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: If even Yun should leave me... Ah, that would be tragedy unbearable! Thank you, good folk, truly!

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: You must've suffered, haven't you? I've brought you your favorite Jueyun Chilis! Come, come, have some!

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Hmm? You're not eating them anymore, Yun? ...Have you learned the wrong lessons while you've been out and about? Come on, eat!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, do Sumpter Beasts even eat Jueyun Chilis?

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: That's what I've been feeding Yun this whole time! Surely I know what it likes!
You're a disgrace, old man... Don't you know that Sumpter Beasts like eating fruit?
Unless they're practically starving, they won't eat Jueyun Chilis — that stuff's bad for their health.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? And who in the world are you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, and here Paimon thought that it might be someone actually important...

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Well, either way, Yun's back with us, so let's head back...
Hey! Don't you ignore me!

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Hmph, alright... you thief.

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Your comrades have all been brought to justice, but still, you dare to say this and that about my precious...

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: "Say"? I'll give you "say." Gainsay, soothsay, hearsay, assay, naysay...

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: ...Essay, unsay...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright, you can stop now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! You, too, calm down! Let's hear them out — we can decide what to do later.
Pfft, a crook, he says... Your Sumpter Beast ran to us of its own accord... The rest locked it up, but I've been taking care of it this whole time.

response.speaker: Tusheng
response.text: Tusheng's the name. Yes, meaning "local-born," because that's exactly what I am.

response.speaker: Tusheng
response.text: As for why I know this and that about Sumpter Beasts, that's because I used to work for a caravan in Sumeru. I came to the Treasure Hoarders because they offered better pay... Pah. Didn't think things would get this dangerous.

response.speaker: Tusheng
response.text: Anyway, your Sumpter Beast... It ate all the Berries I spent three days picking. It must've been starving.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, so it was hungry... That would explain why it ran off...

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: What nonsense! This crook lies! Isn't Chili by my side still?

choices.text: Well, you do have a point there...

response.speaker: Tusheng
response.text: You have another Sumpter Beast? It comes from good stock, I presume? That's to say, a good breed?

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Of course! Hmph... Why do you ask?

response.speaker: Tusheng
response.text: Sumpter Beasts of good breeds can go a long time without eating or drinking, which is what makes them excellent for long-distance transport through both desert and rainforest. *sigh* It's just a shame that some people are willing to spend so much Mora on buying them, but not on caring for them...

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Who're you talking about, huh? What do you mean, "not on caring for them"? So you're an expert, is that it? After studying Sumpter Beasts for just a couple days? Huh?

response.speaker: Tusheng
response.text: I haven't formally studied, no, but I have fed Sumpter Beasts.

response.speaker: Tusheng
response.text: Anyway, Yunyun over here's been living good these past few days, so don't feed it anything weird from now on, alright?

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: You... Cutpurse cretin! Scurrilous slanderer! Well then, if you say Yun's been living well, why don't we have a showdown between it and Chili, then?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? A competition... how, exactly?

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: We'll take them out on a walk, and see which one is in higher spirits! If Chili has a spring in its step, that's how we'll know that this person's been putting Yun through the wringer!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We saw Yun break through the fence earlier — it sure looked pretty lively then. It must've eaten pretty well, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, someone's being unnecessarily competitive...

response.speaker: Tusheng
response.text: Hmph! Who's afraid of you, anyway?

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Fine! Don't you dare leave — come to my camp. That's where Chili is. We'll have it out there!

choices.text: And didn't you have another Sumpter Beast up and leave on you...?

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Jue... Do you mean Jue left because it was hungry? Impossible! Impossible!

response.speaker: Tusheng
response.text: And why would it be impossible? Even people hate places where there isn't enough to eat.

choices.text: Let's just hear what our thieving friend has to... say.

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: S—S—Say... Hmph! Fine, as you wish! Spit it out, you crook!

choices.text: Eek! A wild Treasure Hoarder appeared!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, so spooky!

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: So sneaky!

response.speaker: Yunyun
response.text: Moo!
Oi! Quit making mountains out of molehills, you!

talks.objective: Go to the Treasure Hoarder camp

Oi! Quit making mountains out of molehills, you!

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: See? Chili's doing great! And on the other hand... Yun's doing so poorly it breaks my heart.

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: Are you sure your eyes are working right, old man? Isn't it the other way around?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... Y'know, Paimon can't really tell either way. They just look pretty similar. Maybe we'll need them to walk around a bit to tell.

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Please, could the two of you be our referees? I'm sure you'll be impartial.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And what are the rules, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: We'll just see who gets to the finish line first — Yun, or Chili! I'll have my assistant wait at the finish line.

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: You can go over there now, Mingli.

dialogues.speaker: Mingli
dialogues.text: Yes, Boss.

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: Old man, don't you think you're too tough on the Sumpter Beasts? Especially that Chili of yours, it looks super hungry.

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Hahaha! Scared, young one? Making excuses, are we?

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: What slander. I'm only being considerate! Fine, let's compete! I ain't afraid of you none!

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Heh, let's begin then. I'm about to teach you a good lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Mingli
dialogues.text: Boss, we can start now!

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Okay, begin!

talks.objective: Watch Yunyun and Chili Pepper's competition

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Chili, why aren't you moving either? Do you want some Jueyun Chilis?

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Come, come, I've got lots of them here. You can eat all you want today!

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: That way, you'll have the energy to compete!

dialogues.speaker: Chili Pepper
dialogues.text: (Chili Pepper seems to know what Wenhua's bringing and doesn't even look at it.)

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: This... What's going on? Why aren't you eating anymore?

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: Hey now, come on, didn't you just eat? Are you hungry already?

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: *sigh* What am I supposed to do with you? ... Well, we're fresh out of Berries, but we've still got some Sunsettias. Here, I suppose you'll enjoy these too?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Tusheng retrieves a pile of Sunsettias and places them on the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Yunyun
dialogues.text: (Yunyun starts to eat...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look! Chili Pepper's joining in, too! Guess it wants in on those Sunsettias, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Chili! Not you too...

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: See, I told you so. You're the only one who's enamored with the idea of them liking Jueyun Chilis.

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: How could this be...

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: Whatever. There's nothing to be said to people like you. We can compete once they're done eating their fill.

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: ...Ah, forget it... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: I get it. There's no need for competition now... I know I've lost.

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Perhaps I was too overconfident... But I'm not some bull-headed old fogey!

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: You win, youngster. Looks like Yun and Chili have grown up. If they don't wish to eat Jueyun Chilis any longer, then I'll let them be...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thinks they never did in the first place...

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: Hmm. You know what, old man, you've surprised me... Guess you're pretty alright, learning from your errors and all.

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: ...Youngster, could I ask you a question? How are you so familiar with Sumpter Beast habits?

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: Well, I just like little critters, and Sumpter Beasts are pretty cute when they're young. My family wasn't well-to-do, though, so I couldn't afford to have one.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And that's how you came to steal Yun together with the Treasure Hoarders?

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: Hey, I told you, this one came to us. I stole nothing!

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: Our superiors said that it was just as well that we had a Sumpter Beast, since we got a big deal going recently and would have to transport some large goods — and that's how we came to keep it at our camp.

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Hmph. Even so, taking it for yourself... That's just not right!

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: Well, how were we supposed to know that someone would be raising Sumpter Beasts out here in the boonies!? If we knew we'd end up facing off with this tough a customer, we'd have returned it to you right away!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you wouldn't have returned it so easily had it not been for us, I take it?

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: I see, I see... Well. It's not too late to make up for past mistakes! Well, youngster, ever considered switching careers to work in a caravan?

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: What? I'm not sure I'll have squarer meals with you...

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Square meals? You? Hahaha... You want to eat your fill, do you? Hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Look. Everyone here can attest to you being a Treasure Hoarder, a member of a criminal organization! A single document submitted by me to the Millelith captains, and you'll be eating your fill in a prison cell.

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: But see, I'm a kind soul. Not only am I erasing any record of your guilt, but I'm going to offer you a job, food, and board. What do you say?

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: And how much will I make?

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Ah? Wages... Wages... Well, you can ask the Millelith about that!

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: W—Wait! Please, don't! ... Ugh. You can just decide my paycheck for yourself, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Hmm. Well, in any case, you've impressed me with your abilities. In future, my Sumpter Beasts shall be in your care.

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: I guarantee that not only will you be able to fill your stomach, but that your talents will see ample use indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, uh, this is the first time Paimon's ever seen someone taking advantage of a Treasure Hoarder this much!

choices.text: I suppose you could call this a way out of this life...

response.speaker: Tusheng
response.text: You think so too? Well... To be honest, I quite like the idea of spending time with the Sumpter Beasts...

response.speaker: Tusheng
response.text: Let me give it some thought. I'll let you know once I've thought it through.

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: I believe you'll make the right decision, young man.

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: (I need to find someone to keep an eye on him!)

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: Good, good! Anyway, my good fellows, thank you for helping me reclaim my precious Yun, and bringing it to my attention that they do not like Jueyun Chilis... *sigh* Sorry for the trouble, truly!

response.speaker: Wenhua
response.text: So please, take this as a token of my appreciation. 'Twould be a shame if fine young folks such as yourselves could not eat as they pleased every day!

choices.text: Well, it's better than going to jail.

dialogues.speaker: Mingli
dialogues.text: Hello there. I'm Mingli, the boss's assistant.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why the long face?

dialogues.speaker: Mingli
dialogues.text: I'm worried about my boss... He lost yet another Sumpter Beast... We had three in total, but now we're just down to one!

dialogues.speaker: Mingli
dialogues.text: Sumpter Beasts are quite expensive, and neither my boss nor I know much about keeping them. We're going to take big losses if we keep going like this.

dialogues.speaker: Mingli
dialogues.text: Do you guys think he's getting old and starting to forget things?

dialogues.speaker: Mingli
dialogues.text: It's not over yet? Did something unexpected happen?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's over.

dialogues.speaker: Mingli
dialogues.text: Huh!? Did Boss forget that I'm waiting at the end!? Is his age finally catching up with him...

dialogues.speaker: Mingli
dialogues.text: Perhaps it's time for me to start looking at other options...

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: This is the place. Please, do it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, who's the real bandit here?

dialogues.speaker: Startled Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Hmm!? Who are you? We're with the Iron and Salt Gang, so you'd better watch yourself around us!

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Ah! My Yun! These wicked Treasure Hoarders didn't bully you, did they?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, do you really have to get all that fuzzy-wuzzy with a Sumpter Beast?

dialogues.speaker: Startled Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Hmm!? Who are you? We're with the Iron and Salt Gang, so you'd better watch yourself around us!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are there Treasure Hoarders here too!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, and they're raising that Sumpter Beast? They sure do have time on their hands...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Yunyun's stopped!

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: See? What did I say?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You say that, but... Chili Pepper's stopped, too.

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: They must both be hungry.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! That Sumpter Beast's charging, now that's what Paimon calls energy!
